title: Nonnegativity of uniform expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge0$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Then $\E_x[f(x)]\ge0$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge0$ for every $x$.
Then $\mathbb E[f]\ge0$, where $\mathbb E[f]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}f(x)$.
